key.name: kms-modifiers
key.summary: Always allocate scanout buffers with explicit modifiers
key.description: When true, mutter will always allocate scanout buffers with explicit modifiers, if supported by the driver. This option requires a restart.

key.name: autoclose-xwayland
key.summary: Automatically terminate Xwayland after last client is gone
key.description: When true, mutter will automatically terminate Xwayland after the last relevant client is gone. This option requires a restart.

key.name: tearing
key.description: When true makes mutter change the presentation to Async or Vsync when applicable and if supported by the driver. This option requires a restart.

key.name: auto-fullscreen-tearing
key.summary: Automatically enables tearing for all fullscreen windows
key.description: Automatically enables tearing for all fullscreen windows when tearing support is available. This is separate from the “tearing” feature which enables per-app tearing control. Automatically enables base “tearing” feature if not set.
